about: Signature log lines, wave 1 (AnimalDex decision 374, English first): for a species and one of its recipes, the species' own sentence for what that recipe shows, from AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json (the row's line; rows mapped to an existing recipe the species has). Said in the live log in place of the generic line while that recipe's episode is in view. Lines that name a sex, a life stage, a season or a time of day are held back until the log checks the actor and the moment. Read against each recipe on 2026-11-16: 54 lines cut where the sentence says another action than the recipe shows, or names a time, season, weather or partner species the recipe does not guarantee.
